title: PostgreSQL
blurb: Internals, MVCC and VACUUM, roles and backups, replication and HA, tuning and extensions.

quiz.question: In PostgreSQL MVCC, an UPDATE…
options: Writes a new row version and marks the old one with xmax
quiz.explanation: Old versions remain for concurrent snapshots until VACUUM removes them.

quiz.question: What most commonly prevents VACUUM from removing dead tuples?
options: A long-running or idle-in-transaction session holding back the xmin horizon
quiz.explanation: Kill or time out long transactions with idle_in_transaction_session_timeout.

quiz.question: Why is PgBouncer commonly used?
options: Each connection is a process, so pooling lets many clients share few server connections
quiz.explanation: Transaction pooling gives the biggest multiplier.

quiz.question: Which backup approach allows restoring to a specific second?
options: Base backup plus continuous WAL archiving (PITR)
Copying the data directory while running
quiz.explanation: Replay archived WAL up to a target time.

quiz.question: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES is needed because…
options: GRANT ON ALL TABLES does not cover tables created later
quiz.explanation: Without it, new tables are invisible to the app role.

quiz.question: Synchronous replication guarantees…
options: No loss of committed transactions if the primary fails (for the sync standby)
quiz.explanation: The commit waits for a standby to confirm the WAL.

quiz.question: Split-brain in HA means…
options: Two nodes accepting writes as primary at once
quiz.explanation: Consensus-based managers like Patroni prevent it with a leader lock.

quiz.question: Why create indexes with CONCURRENTLY in production?
options: It avoids blocking writes during the build
quiz.explanation: A plain CREATE INDEX blocks writes on the table.

quiz.question: In EXPLAIN ANALYZE, estimated rows=1 vs actual rows=80000 suggests…
options: Bad statistics, so run ANALYZE or add extended statistics
quiz.explanation: Misestimates lead to bad join and scan choices.

quiz.question: Which extension adds vector similarity search?
quiz.explanation: pgvector adds vector types and HNSW/IVFFlat indexes.

quiz.question: random_page_cost on SSD storage should usually be…
quiz.explanation: The default of 4 assumes spinning disks and under-uses indexes.

problems.title: Diagnose table bloat
problems.prompt: A 5 GB table has grown to 70 GB. Walk through diagnosis and the fix.
problems.solution: Check n_dead_tup and last_autovacuum, look for long transactions or abandoned slots blocking cleanup, check HOT update ratios and indexes on frequently updated columns, tune per-table autovacuum, set idle_in_transaction_session_timeout, lower fillfactor, then rebuild online with pg_repack.

problems.title: Least-privilege roles
problems.prompt: Create roles so the app can read and write data but cannot change the schema, and BI is read-only, including future tables.
problems.solution: Create shop_owner/app_rw/app_ro group roles, grant DML or SELECT on the schema, ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE shop_owner, create login roles IN ROLE the group roles, and run migrations as the owner.

problems.title: Zero-data-loss HA
problems.prompt: Design PostgreSQL HA with zero data loss for a single-zone failure and disaster recovery for a region failure.
problems.solution: Run three nodes across zones with Patroni and an etcd quorum, synchronous_standby_names = ANY 1 of the two in-region standbys, an async standby plus pgBackRest WAL archiving in another region, HAProxy routing on Patroni health checks, app retries, and regular failover drills.

problems.title: Speed up a dashboard query
problems.prompt: A query filtering by restaurant_id and active statuses, ordered by created_at, scans 14M rows.
problems.solution: Create a partial index on (restaurant_id, created_at DESC) WHERE status IN (active ones) CONCURRENTLY, rewrite date(created_at)=X as a half-open range, add extended statistics if estimates are off, and use keyset pagination.
